en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing an ornate city square dominated by an equestrian statue atop a decorative stone bridge or pedestal. The background features elaborate fin-de-siècle (late 19th–early 20th century) buildings with intricate façades and a prominent spire. Trees and an ornate metal fence frame the foreground. An emblem in the bottom left reads 'Foto Lini Club.'
